#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(NULL);
    
    int n, K;
    cin >> n >> K;
    vector<vector<int>> ts(K, vector<int>(2));
    long long all = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < K; ++i) {
        cin >> ts[i][0] >> ts[i][1];
        all += ts[i][1] - ts[i][0];
    }
    
    const int INF = 99999999;
    vector<int> dpe(n + 1, INF);
    vector<int> dpo(n + 1, INF);
    
    if (ts[0][0] > n) {
        cout << "Hungry" << endl;
        return 0;
    }
    dpe[ts[0][0]] = 0;
    
    for (int i = 0; i < K; ++i) {
        vector<int> ndpo(n + 1, INF);
        vector<int> ndpe(n + 1, INF);
        
        vector<int> dq(n + 2);
        int head = 0, tail = 0;
        int w = ts[i][1] - ts[i][0];
        
        // First pass using dpe
        for (int j = 0; j <= n; ++j) {
            while (tail > head && dpe[dq[tail - 1]] >= dpe[j]) tail--;
            while (tail > head && dq[head] < j - w) head++;
            dq[tail++] = j;
            ndpo[j] = min(ndpo[j], dpe[dq[head]] + 1);
            if (j + w <= n) ndpe[j + w] = min(ndpe[j + w], dpe[j]);
        }
        
        head = tail = 0;
        // Second pass using dpo
        for (int j = 0; j <= n; ++j) {
            while (tail > head && dpo[dq[tail - 1]] >= dpo[j]) tail--;
            while (tail > head && dq[head] < j - w) head++;
            dq[tail++] = j;
            ndpe[j] = min(ndpe[j], dpo[dq[head]] + 1);
            ndpo[j] = min(ndpo[j], dpo[j]);
        }
        
        dpo = ndpo;
        dpe = ndpe;
        
        // Cross updates
        for (int j = 0; j <= n; ++j) {
            dpe[j] = min(dpe[j], dpo[j] + 1);
            dpo[j] = min(dpo[j], dpe[j] + 1);
        }
        
        // Shift for next interval
        int s = (i == K - 1 ? 2 * n : ts[i + 1][0]) - ts[i][1];
        for (int j = n; j >= s; --j) {
            dpe[j] = dpe[j - s];
        }
        for (int j = min(n, s - 1); j >= 0; --j) {
            dpe[j] = INF;
        }
    }
    
    int ans = min(dpe[n], dpo[n]);
    if (ans >= 9999999) {
        cout << "Hungry" << endl;
    } else {
        cout << "Full" << endl;
        cout << ans << endl;
    }
    
    return 0;
}
